user_saw: Nothing functionally wrong; broad sessions_search calls did somewhat more Gateway main-thread work on large archives (about 12% more CPU in a synthetic 3,500-session benchmark).
summary: Replaced sessions_search's paged active+archived full-row listing (repeated for the requester's agent) with one tagged dashboard summary inventory plus an exact requester-owned global lookup, and added that lookup to the embedded Gateway adapter.
reasoning: The PR is a performance optimization measured on a synthetic workload with unchanged search results; it reports no user incident and does not claim an earlier commit made discovery slower. The duplicate-scan design was how the tool's discovery was written, so this is a performance improvement of code that was never faster, which the rubric treats as not-a-defect.
